write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for pharmacy technician work! At Sutter Valley Medical Center, you show sterile compounding, cabinet restocking and training alongside the volume you handle. Your earlier RiteCare work adds retail pharmacy experience.

The cabinet restocking line is a great model: it names the work, the nursing units and the change in stockout reports. Your role history and duties are in separate tables, though, so a recruiter has to match them up.
Put each duty under its corresponding role so the work and employer are together. Your resume doesn't need a major overhaul; how competitive a particular job is will matter too.
